To: @renee.whitlock
Replying to: s01
Cc: none
Subject: Football rundown for Monday admin meeting — draft

Renee, here's our rundown for the noon meeting. Been a good week for these kids.

We beat Brookhollow 31-14 Friday and locked up second in the region. Deshawn Pettaway had 3 sacks and 7 tackles. The kids voted him defensive player of the week in the locker room before the coaches even met. That says a lot about how his teammates saw his night. Defense held Brookhollow to 46 yards rushing in the second half.

Tavion Hurst finished with 188 yards rushing and 2 touchdowns. His long TD in the third was a big one, but I want to give that offensive line their credit too. They were pushing them 5 yards back that whole drive. Best I've seen them block all year.

We've got a HOME playoff game Friday, Nov. 13, against Clanton Valley, 7 p.m. at Ridge Field. Please make sure Dr. Pruitt gets that one. We'd love folks to come out and get behind these boys. Presale tickets start Tuesday. Gate crew and chain crew still need confirming by Wednesday, and boosters need 6 more people for concessions. That signup sheet goes out today.

On grades, all 52 players are eligible after the nine-week check. Nobody on the list. Tonya Greer deserves the credit for that, not me. Her Tuesday and Thursday study hall is paying off, and she's keeping it going through the playoffs.

The Boston butt sale finished at 208 sold and $6,240 raised, beating the $4,500 goal by $1,740. That money is going toward new sideline headsets. Appreciate Carla and the boosters getting it done, and Hargrove's Meat Market smoking them at cost.

If we win and go on the road, I'll get the bus stuff to you. I've got the five-day advance requirement in mind.
